summary: Website-wide polish and refactor effort to improve page UX consistency, remove duplicate functions, and make interactions more seamless.
architectural_notes: Refactor and deduplicate shared functions into centralized utilities/components to improve maintainability and consistency across pages.

existing_features.title: Polish UI/UX across all existing pages so they feel consistent and seamless: align typography scale, spacing, page headings, section layout, and empty/loading/error states across Landing, Browse, Listing Detail, Listing Form, My Tools, Requests, My Rentals, Rental Detail, Messaging, Profile, and Community Map pages.

Introduce shared frontend utilities/components to eliminate duplicated logic and mappings currently repeated across pages/components (e.g., rental status label/color mapping and date formatting). Replace page-local implementations with shared imports.

Remove dead/duplicate frontend code and placeholders, and ensure the codebase has no unused exports/imports related to removed files. In particular, address the empty placeholder hook file frontend/src/hooks/useMapZoom.ts by either removing it or implementing it and consolidating map zoom behavior into a single, clearly-named hook without duplication.

Make cross-page interactions feel seamless by standardizing navigation and action patterns: consistent primary/secondary CTAs, consistent link styling, and predictable placement of key actions (e.g., “Add Tool”, “View Details”, “Manage Rentals/Requests”) across relevant pages.

Apply a single coherent visual theme across the app (colors, typography, surface styles, radii, shadows) and enforce it consistently using existing Tailwind + shadcn primitives; keep the theme neutral and modern (avoid a blue/purple-dominant palette).

new_feature_requests.summary: Polish all website pages for more seamless UX and refactor to remove duplicate functions/code

projectName: Website-wide polish pass and refactor to remove duplicate code
